name: EPIC 212418305
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 16.6 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,487 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.85 solar masses and 16.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,366 K at its surface.
